newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy bourse regulator wants more Olivetti details.
newsitem.headline: Italy bourse regulator wants more Olivetti details.

text.p: Enzo Berlanda, the head of Italy's stock market regulatory authority, Consob, said on Tuesday that he still did not have enough information to be sure that Olivetti's first half results were accurate.
Berlanda told a hearing in the Italian upper house: "Consob still does not have any auditing backup to be convinced of the accounting accuracy of the first half report."

The future of the loss-making information technology group was plunged into uncertainty after a former director general, Renzo Francesconi, resigned earlier this month and accused Olivetti of concealing its true financial situation.

Olivetti last week presented detailed answers to 16 questions put to it by Consob but said it would not give information about its net financial indebtedness at end-August until the first week of October.
